question: A cistern can be filled with water by a pipe in 10 hours, and it can be emptied by asecond pipe in 8 hours. If both the pipes are opened when the cistern is full, the time in which it will be emptied is:
solution:
**Given:**

Filling pipe time = 10 hrs

Emptying pipe time = 8 hrs

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of times

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Net work rate = Emptying efficiency − Filling efficiency

Time taken = Total work ÷ Net rate

**Calculations:**

LCM(10, 8) = 40 units

Filling efficiency = 40 ÷ 10 = 4 units/hr

Emptying efficiency = 40 ÷ 8 = 5 units/hr

Net rate = 5 − 4 = 1 unit/hr (emptying)

Time taken = 40 ÷ 1 = 40 hrs

**∴ The cistern will be emptied in 40 hours.**
